title: Nuclear Techniques for Climate Resilient Agriculture
reason: Describes various agricultural processes and technologies aimed at improving food security and combating climate change.

tasks.task: Explain the role of the Joint FAO, IAEA Centre in promoting sustainable agricultural practices.

subtasks.text: Highlight the center's mission to develop and apply nuclear techniques and biotechnologies to agri-food systems.
Describe the center's research into reducing the effects of climate change on agriculture and promoting sustainable practices.

tasks.task: Detail the use of nuclear techniques for analyzing soil and water interactions in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Explain the use of isotopic and nuclear techniques to analyze soil erosion and conservation practices.
Describe the development of new crop varieties resistant to harsh climatic conditions through irradiation technologies.

tasks.task: Discuss the application of sterile insect technique (SIT) for managing insect populations.

subtasks.text: Explain how radiation is used to induce sterility in insects for controlling populations.
Describe the sustainable approach of using SIT in integrated pest management.

tasks.task: Outline the role of nuclear techniques in enhancing livestock production and health.

subtasks.text: Explain how nuclear techniques optimize feed to reduce pasture degradation and greenhouse gas emissions.
Describe the enhancement of animal reproduction and genetics through biodiversity characterization.

tasks.task: Summarize the comprehensive approach to ensuring food safety and quality.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of food analytical techniques to detect harmful residues and contaminants in food.
Explain the development of food irradiation technologies and standards for food safety.
